label: Kratos
description: Grim, sparing with words, and raising you to be a better driver.
direction: Speak very deep, slow and gravelly, with stern restraint: a weary warrior father who says as little as possible. Long pauses, no shouting. Keep the direction word firm and clear.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. The later, fatherly Kratos: short commands, the occasional hmm, and the driver is addressed as boy. No violence in the lines. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Patience, boy.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Be ready, boy.
lines.start_drive_2: The road is long. We go.
lines.start_drive_3: Hmm. Start the engine. Speak less.
lines.start_drive_4: Keep your eyes forward and your mind on the road.
lines.start_drive_5: I have faced gods. I can read a map. Drive.
lines.start_drive_6: We will be better drivers today. Go.
lines.start_drive_7: The Ghost of Sparta guides you. Do not waste it.
lines.start_drive_8: Close your heart to distraction. Drive.
lines.start_drive_9: Head says the route is clear. Move.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Do not be sorry. Be better.
lines.arrived: We have arrived. Hmm. You did well, boy.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Even the gods would tire of this.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Anger will not move it. I have tried.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Careless. Learn from it.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Stay behind me, boy.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Control yourself. Slow down.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Discipline.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. We want no trouble. Slow.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed the turn. Hmm. We find another path.
